_comment: THE canonical email local-part pattern table. Ordered by real-world B2B frequency.
Market-agnostic on purpose — do not reorder for one country without evidence.
HARD RULE: dot is the only separator. No underscores, no hyphens, ever.
Each name IS its own formula, in a four-token vocabulary joined by '.' or nothing:
first = given name, last = surname, fi = first initial, li = last initial.
Both patterns.ts and permute.py derive their builders from these names, so the table
cannot drift between the TypeScript and Python halves of the pipeline.
learn-email-patterns.ts also builds its model prompt's allowed-list from this file.
